notes.title: CRAFT/TRADE SYSTEM !
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, thank you for your patiences. We are here for a new update today. We added Craft/Trade system to our game. Now you can use your monster to get new rare monsters. We wish you a big luck.

We are currently discuss about Daily/Weekly boss system. You can get rare rewards from this bosses. (We will kill the bosses as a community)

Also please don't forget to review our game from the steam page.

Thank you everyone. See you on next update. ❤️


Discord: https://discord.gg/J5gmcQFh25

notes.title: NEW MONSTERS ARE HERE !
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

For our release day we add very rare monsters to pool. You can collect them by a small chance depends on their rarity level. You can see our new friends at the bottom of this post.

Added Monster Names: "Panther" < "Golem" < "Slug Queen" < "Flying Demon" < "Cerberus" < "Fancy Worm"

Happy release day. Wish you a big luck! ❤️

notes.title: Release Day !!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We would like to announce with excitement that our game has been published. We would like to thank everyone who accompanied us on our BETA journey. With the release of our game, the chance to win "Alpha Wyvern", which was exclusive to the BETA version, has ended. 

We will continue to offer you new events and new monsters. Please stay tuned for the next events. ^^

Good luck everyone. ❤️
-Monsters Dev Team-

🥳 🥳 🥳
